title: Understanding L2 Loss
text: The L2 loss, also known as the mean squared error, is minimized when the predicted value is the mean of the observed values.

title: Mean of Critic 1's Ratings
text: The mean of $$critic_{1's}$$ ratings is given as $$85$$. This is the value that minimizes the L2 loss for a constant prediction model.
